sloka: रावणग्रहणं तत्तु वायुग्रहणसन्निभम् ।ततः पुलस्त्यः शुश्राव कथितं दिवि दैवतैः ।। ७.३३.१ ॥
transliteration: rāvaṇagrahaṇaṁ tattu vāyugrahaṇasannibham ।tataḥ pulastyaḥ śuśrāva kathitaṁ divi daivataiḥ ।। 7.33.1 ॥

translations.english: The capture of Ravana was as futile as trying to grasp the wind, and Pulastya heard the gods speaking of this in heaven.
